receiving_iona_come_look.speaker: IONA
receiving_iona_come_look.text: Ro. You’re in Receiving. Your name’s still on the handover. Come look at what it calls empty.

receiving_iona_freight_one.speaker: IONA
receiving_iona_freight_one.text: Freight One is eleven metres up. Find firm footing there. The crane yard is ahead.

freight_one_iona_crown.speaker: IONA
freight_one_iona_crown.text: Our freight line still shares the construction return at the Crown. They remove that, we lose the way up. We need it separated.

receiving_iona_keep_the_height.speaker: IONA
receiving_iona_keep_the_height.text: You’ve found your way up. Keep the height. The Crown is still above you.

receiving_iona_recovery.speaker: IONA
receiving_iona_recovery.text: Find your footing. You can try another way up.

vale_contact_ro.speaker: RO
vale_contact_ro.text: You kept me as your emergency contact?

vale_contact_iona.speaker: IONA
vale_contact_iona.text: They asked for next of kin. Not a fucking recommendation.

double_ari_job.speaker: ARI
double_ari_job.text: I was hired to attend your handovers.

double_ro_empty.speaker: RO
double_ro_empty.text: You told them the rooms were empty.

double_ari_cannot.speaker: ARI
double_ari_cannot.text: That's not something I can hand back.

handover_record_assurance.speaker: RECORD
handover_record_assurance.text: No occupied areas remain within the handover boundary.

handover_iona_revision.speaker: IONA
handover_iona_revision.text: Your survey says access withdrawn. Occupancy not assessed. They changed the conclusion and kept your name.

handover_iona_gallery.speaker: IONA
handover_iona_gallery.text: Ari Ward. Barrel Helix landing, two hundred and fifty-three metres. Find them. Ask what they were told.

handover_source_survey.speaker: SOURCE
handover_source_survey.text: Temporary construction access withdrawn. Occupancy not assessed.

arrival_iona_empty_record.speaker: IONA
arrival_iona_empty_record.text: Ro. They used your name to call this yard empty. That man is still working. Get to Freight One, eleven metres up. We need the original handover.

arrival_iona_personnel_way.speaker: IONA
arrival_iona_personnel_way.text: The hanging mesh on the front of the tower gets the crew up to Freight One. Follow the open ground around the steel stores.

arrival_iona_mesh_lip.speaker: IONA
arrival_iona_mesh_lip.text: There's a steel lip above you. Stay close to the mesh and climb until you can reach over it.

arrival_iona_first_ring.speaker: IONA
arrival_iona_first_ring.text: That's Freight One. The cabinet against the wall gets you onto the duct. Follow it to the vent. The next ring is above it. Keep heading for the original handover.

service_iona_inspection_rail.speaker: IONA
service_iona_inspection_rail.text: Along the wall, there's a narrow rail under a hanging ladder. Walk out beneath it, then jump for a rung. This is still a working access route, Ro. The handover says it isn't.
